subject.title: fix(agents): stop tool discovery from breaking prompt caches

question: Should existing Tool Search directory-mode users intentionally move from prompt-selected direct plugin schemas to the PR’s stable directory/search/describe/call workflow in exchange for deterministic provider prompt-cache reuse?
rationale: The code and proof support the cache-stability invariant, but choosing the upgrade behavior for already opted-in directory-mode users is a product compatibility decision rather than a mechanical correctness question.

options.title: Confirm stable directory mode
options.body: Accept the documented directory-mode upgrade behavior so provider-visible tool prefixes remain deterministic across turns and discovery orders.

options.title: Preserve prompt-selected schemas
options.body: Keep the prior direct-schema behavior for existing directory-mode users, accepting that it weakens the cache-stability guarantee and reintroduces prompt-dependent request prefixes.

options.title: Pause for narrower policy
options.body: Hold the PR until maintainers define a different explicit compatibility contract for directory-mode direct tool exposure.

recommendation.title: Confirm stable directory mode
recommendation.body: Accept the documented directory-mode upgrade behavior so provider-visible tool prefixes remain deterministic across turns and discovery orders.

likelyOwner.reason: The implementation author is the available routing contact for the cache-stability and Tool Search design evidence; final product acceptance remains with repository maintainers.
